title: Kazna Pack
description: packs/{id}/pack.json, the file the app installs a pack from. validate.py checks every pack against this schema. A pack's rank, countries and default category are not here but in meta/packs.json, which build.py reads with the packs.

pinnedBankKey.description: Six global-banks keys from before keys were kebab-case. The app's seed pins them, so they can never be renamed. New keys use the slug pattern.

localizedString.description: Text by language code. English is required; the app falls back to it for any language the map lacks.

countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes. null means international, with no home country.

aliases.description: Other names people search by: former names, short forms, other scripts ("Сбер", "Tinkoff"). Only the v2 index reads them, so adding them needs no version bump. meta/entities.json overrides them.

countries.description: Only the v2 index reads this, so changing it needs no version bump. Overrides the countries of the packs that list the key (meta/packs.json); meta/entities.json overrides it in turn.

category.description: A category id from meta/categories.json, in place of the pack's default (meta/packs.json). Only the v2 index reads it, so changing it needs no version bump; meta/entities.json overrides it.

match.description: "pick": the name is too generic (МЕТРО, Claude), so the app suggests the brand but never links a payee of the user's to it by name alone. Read only at install and update, which download the pack anew, so adding it needs no version bump.

logo.description: Optional: a bank with no usable logo (a closed one, say) is shown by its initial.

countries.description: null means an international bank with no home country.

card_background.description: The colour of the bank's cards, applied to a new account's card.

brand.description: The bank group this entry is one country of. A group with a main entry takes its key ("sberbank" for sberbank-by), and the main entry has no brand; a group without one shares a name no bank has as a key ("tbc" for tbc-ge and tbc-uz). The app shows each group as one bank.
